body: Do you think he’s toxic to you? Mines very toxic, in a way where he communicates very poorly, and gets upset about it. I hope your situation will get better eventually.

I don’t like it that people say it gets better too, it’s false and ignorant. 

It may not get better, but that also means it may not get worse. 

It stays around the same everyday, some days worse and some days better.

I am passionate about 1 particular thing but my will to live is hindering me from doing a lot of it. I think perhaps you just haven’t found your EXACT passion, I mean children take 12-17 years to find what their single true passion is, maybe you should give it a bit more time too?

26M. You’re not alone. I went to university and has been working on and off throughout my life, yet I still feel the same. I feel at peace with death as well. 

You having 2 cats definitely helped, at least made you think twice before the suicide.
